item.title: ICMA Gala Concert 2026 to be streamed live on Deutsche Welle
item.description: The 2026 International Classical Music Awards (ICMA) gala concert will take place on March 18 at 8:00 p.m. in Bamberg, Germany.

item.title: 50th Innsbrucker Festwochen der Alten Musik announces anniversary programme
item.description: 'What do we celebrate?' This question lies at the heart of the anniversary of the Innsbrucker Festwochen der Alten Musik.

item.title: Miha Zhu wins the 2026 Leipzig Bach Competition violin category
item.description: Winners of the second and third prizes come from France and the Netherlands. The Audience Prize also goes to Miha Zhu.

item.title: Prestigious International Jury Announced for the 20th Anniversary George Enescu International Competition
item.description: From August 23 to September 19, 2026, Bucharest will host the 20th anniversary edition of the George Enescu International Competition, themed “In Pursuit of Excellence.”

item.title: Silenced Voices: MÁV Symphony Orchestra and Maxim Rysanov to Perform at BMC
item.description: On April 24, the Budapest Music Center (BMC) will host a powerful concert of remembrance featuring the MÁV Symphony Orchestra and the world-renowned Ukrainian-born conductor and violist Maxim Rysanov.

item.title: Twelve Choirs Set to Compete in the 30th Anniversary Béla Bartók International Choir Competition
item.description: Founded in 1961 and revitalized in 2024, the Béla Bartók International Choir Competition (BBCC) is reaching a historic milestone.

item.title: The Famous Esterhazy Jewels’ Auction in London was 159 years ago
item.description: The famous gem collection of the Esterhazy family, the ”Celebrated Esterhazy Jewels” were auctioned at Christie’s in London in the spring of 1867.

item.title: Classical:NEXT debuts in Hungary in 8 April
item.description: Classical:NEXT, the world’s largest international gathering for classical and art music professionals is taking place in Budapest from 8–11 April 2026.

item.title: Honouring Innovation at Classical:NEXT
item.description: The thirteenth edition of Classical:NEXT, produced in partnership with Hangvető and Bartók Spring International Arts Weeks, honoured the top three recipients of the 2026 Innovation Award on Friday at the Budapest Music Center with a celebration of creativity, innovation and community.

item.title: Katowice to host Classical:NEXT 2027
item.description: Katowice has been announced as the host city of Classical:NEXT 2027. The event will take place from 11 to 14 May 2027 as part of the Polish Capital of Culture 2027 programme.

item.title: Avant Première 2026: Shaping the Future of Cultural Media on Screen
item.description: From 14–18 February 2026, Berlin became the hub of global cultural broadcasting and performing arts on screen as the IMZ International Music + Media Centre presented Avant Première 2026 at the Scandic Hotel Potsdamer Platz.

item.title: 44 Young Chamber Music Ensembles Join MERITA Platform for 2024–2029 Cycle
item.description: The MERITA Platform has announced the selection of 44 young chamber music ensembles (22 piano trios and 22 string quartets) for MERITAcubed.

item.title: postWinterreise - When Schubert's music meets melting ice
item.description: postWinterreise is a fragmentation of Schubert's Winterreise performed in a sculptural installation of melting ice, flowing water, and resonant objects.

item.title: Shifting Stages - IMZ launches new magazine
item.description: Centred around the theme “Shifting Stages”, the first edition brings together a wide range of perspectives across the audiovisual performing arts industry.

item.title: The registration is open for Zoltán Tuska's chamber music masterclass
item.description: One of the most exciting courses in the János Rolla mentoring program, held at the Óbudai Társaskör, will be led by Kossuth Prize-winning violinist Zoltán Tuska.
